name: Creamy Hummus Pasta with Kale, Roasted Peppers, Olives & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place hummus, milk, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, remove sauce from heat, cover with a lid to keep warm, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups hummus
355 ml whole milk
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is heating, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers and olives. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the peppers and olives, then set aside.
When the pasta is almost done, add kale to the pot and stir to combine. Continue to cook until pasta and kale are tender, 2-3 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (283 g) bags kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta and kale in a colander. Return to the pot along with the sauce, peppers, olives, and basil; gently stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls, then top with feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

line_items.ingredient_name: kale, cut and ready to use
